verdict.rationale: Twilio's Video pricing page documents phone dial-in and dial-out for video calls, and the product page mentions PSTN calling and Voice integration. However, this capability is delivered through the separate Twilio Voice product and appears only in short marketing statements. missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on how phone participants join a Room, any SIP-specific dial-in/dial-out evidence, documentation of limits and configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, phone callers join a session through documented SIP or PSTN dial-in and dial-out

citations.quote: Dial in and dial out of video calls with phone numbers via Twilio Voice.
Add real-time voice and PSTN calling to your web applications
